text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day before the debut race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While waiting on the terrace of our accommodation near Hakodate Racecourse
for Dantsu Flame to return from shopping—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha! Really?
That sounds super interesting—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! I'm so sorry,
you were waiting outside for me?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Hello~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, Dantsu Flame returned
accompanied by a large crowd of Umamusume.
choice_data_list: Hello... Um, are they your friend?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, are we... friends now?
Of course we are!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Well, someone was lost, and when I talked to her, she turned out to be one of the race entrants.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: While we were chatting, we realized we were staying at the same place. So I started guiding them back, and our group just kept growing and growing—

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Man, Dantsu, you really saved my bacon.
I almost had to sleep outside~

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I never thought I'd have so much fun
chatting with people who are gonna be my rivals tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that reminds me—did you want to try
that foundation I recommended earlier?

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
"I'll try it! I'll lend you my hair oil in return~!
Actually, I bought way too many snacks earlier, so let's all eat 'em together~!
Umm, where to—"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Oh, weren't there some open common spaces
in the hotel, if I remember right?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Wait, really!? Let's go~!

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, this hair oil is amazing!
It makes my hair super glossy!

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
Right, right?
The subtle scent is really nice too!

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
You're right~!
Amazing, where did you find it?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just to make sure they didn't get too carried away and stay up all night, I went to check on them now and then, but the atmosphere remained peaceful from start to finish.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Well then, see you tomorrow!
Let's meet in the paddock♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With smiles on their faces,
the participating Umamusume returned to their respective rooms.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yup.
See you later, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...
Hehe. That was fun. Thank you as well, Trainer,
even though it was so sudden.
choice_data_list: Not at all. Well then, see you tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Yes—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
O-Oh, that's right! I bought some tea at the convenience store
earlier. I got one for you too, Trainer,
so please take it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dants Flame rummages through her luggage.
—And at that moment, a bottle
tumbles out of her bag.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was the exact same hair oil
that everyone was getting excited about earlier.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yes, exactly!
It smells so good, it's my favorite~.
choice_data_list: (...Did she stay quiet to let her have the spotlight?)
(...She stayed quiet so she could have the spotlight.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: By the time they were heading home, the Umamusume had completely opened up to each other. The reason everyone was able to have such a pleasant time might just be—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it was thanks to Dants Flame,
who continued to show casual, quiet consideration.
choice_data_list: (She must have a lot of friends.)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Here, this is for you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Blending into the atmosphere and effortlessly keeping things smooth—
I could sense Dants Flame's exceptional
communication skills.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then came the day of the debut race.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Phew!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Alright.
I'd better head over soon...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, y-yes!
Of-of cowse—"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Pfft.
Ahaha, you're way too nervous!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but somehow...
that made me feel a little lighter just now!
choice_data_list: That's wonderful! Now go do your best!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes!
I'll do my b-best...! Here I go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In complete contrast to yesterday—
carrying an air of fresh, youthful nervousness,
the curtain rose on the debut race!
